page.title: Earning
page.purpose: Let the minter record work done directly and see what the connected adapters are reporting, with operator entry as an equal path rather than a fallback.

priorities.statement: Recording an earning by hand is presented as an ordinary action, not a workaround.
priorities.notes: Several real earning sources will never have an API; the operator is a first-class adapter.

priorities.statement: Which adapters are connected and what they last reported is visible.
A replayed submission is shown as recognised rather than as an error.
